subject: Request for provisional throughput uplift & billing reconciliation plan
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@oliveai.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@oliveai.com
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Production launch — short-term capacity increase

Hi Aditya,

We're ramping a new feature next week and expect a concentrated traffic spike for two weeks after GA (estimated +250% tokens/day on the first 10 days). Our current committed capacity will not cover the burst and we need a short-term, guaranteed throughput uplift with transparent billing so we can sign the PO quickly.

Questions: 1) Can Redwood provision a provisional quota uplift starting 6/1 for ~14 days? 2) How will billing be handled — prorated overage vs. a temporary add-on? 3) Any ability to cap spend or set hard guards so we don't exceed a specific dollar limit?

I've attached our traffic forecast and can share a consolidated purchase order once we align on approach. We're timeboxed here and would appreciate a concrete option set today.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Platform Operations, OliveAI
procurement@oliveai.com

Attachment: oliveai_prod_traffic_forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)
From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>

Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production launch — short-term capacity increase

Samira — thanks for the heads up and for the attached forecast. We can support this but there are a few ways to structure it depending on OliveAI's tolerance for spend and procurement preferences. High-level options below; I'll loop in Finance/CS for final numbers.

Option A — Temporary uplift (no commitment):
- We enable a provisional quota uplift for the 14-day window.
- Billing: Overrun billed at an elevated per-token rate (X% over baseline); fully refundable credits not included.
- Spend guard: We can set a hard token cap and alerting; once hit, we can throttle or fail requests depending on your preference.

Option B — Short-term add-on (discounted):
- We provision a 14-day add-on SKU with a fixed price that covers the uplift volume based on your forecast.
- Billing: Single invoice/PO; lower unit price vs. Option A.
- Converts to committed capacity if you choose within 30 days (pro-rated).

Option C — Safety-first mode (hybrid):
- Immediate provisional uplift with hard spend cap + opt-in to convert a portion to a short-term commit for a discount.

Next steps I suggest: Laura (billing) to provide exact pricing tiers and a quote PDF, Marissa (CS) to confirm the runtime/config implications and whether we should enable prefix caching to reduce token burn during the spike. If OliveAI can provide a PO for the add-on, Legal/Finance will prioritize.

Laura/Marissa — can you please produce a quote and the operational checklist for a 14-day uplift by EOD?

Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Production launch — short-term capacity increase (proposal attached)

Hi team — attaching a formal 14-day uplift quote and three billing approaches so Samira can pick what suits OliveAI's procurement. Summary below and details are in the attached PDF.

Summary of proposed approaches (numbers illustrative — finalized in PDF):
1) Pay-as-you-go uplift (fastest): +40% per-token uplift rate; billed on monthly invoice for consumed overage; immediate provisioning.
2) 14-day fixed add-on (recommended for predictability): $18k flat to cover forecasted uplift (applies only to specified token bands). Invoice upon PO; lower per-token cost vs option 1.
3) Commit-convert (best unit economics): Short-term 30-day commit for the uplift volume at a 15% discount vs baseline; requires brief approval but can be backdated to cover the spike.

Operational checklist (for CS):
- Enable temporary quota uplift in control plane on 06/01 00:00 UTC.
- Pre-warm KV cache and set prefix caching rules to reduce duplicate tokenization.
- Set spend guard at $25k with auto-alerts and hard throttle behavior (choice: throttle vs fail requests).

Attachments: redwood_temp_uplift_quote.pdf (proposal + pricing matrix)

Samira — if you confirm Option 2, we'll send a Quote #RQ-OLV-0527 and an invoice template for your PO. If you prefer Option 1, we can provision immediately and note the overage rate; Finance will reconcile the final invoice.

-Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Thanks Marissa and Aditya — appreciate the fast turnaround. OliveAI will take Option 2 (14-day fixed add-on) to keep billing predictable for our finance team. A couple of clarifications: 1) Can you confirm the exact start/end timestamps (UTC) so our infra team can align traffic shaping? 2) We will submit a PO for $18,000 today referencing Quote #RQ-OLV-0527. 3) Can Redwood provide a simple email confirmation that the uplift will be isolated to our tenant and that logs will be available for audit?

Assuming positive answers, we'll route the PO to procurement and expect minimal legal redlines.

I'll attach the PO once it's issued.

Best,
Samira
